a.lede: For years, influencers have come up with workarounds on social media to figure out how to share affiliate links with followers. A new integration between Instagram and Amazon was announced earlier this month as a way to make it easier for influencers to make money from affiliate links - but some content creators are suspicious […]
a.title: Some creators are skeptical of Instagram’s new affiliate program

b.lede: The Meta-owned social media platform now lets creators attach up to 30 affiliate links per Reel to make money from Amazon more easily.
b.title: Instagram Is Bringing Amazon Affiliate Links Directly to Reels and Posts
